name: watermark-remover
description: Hapus watermark AI video (visible + invisible + metadata) memakai GPU lokal

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BE,FE,APP "backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn app:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cross-env ELEC_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --prefix frontend && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build --prefix frontend && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
